results.fact: Approach: Skookum Pasture logging road vs Elbow Lake Trail / Green Creek
results.correct_value: Approach is the Elbow Lake Trail (north trailhead, FR 38), ford of the Middle Fork Nooksack, then the blazed Green Creek climbers' path into the Green Creek Cirque; no logging-road/timberland-gate approach.
results.evidence: A Green Creek Circuit trip report starts at the Elbow Lake Trailhead, crosses the Middle Fork Nooksack and follows the blue-marked Green Creek climbers' trail into the cirque before reaching Skookum via Jaws' Tooth. A separate guide-service trip report gives the same approach: FR 38 to the Elbow Lake trailhead (2,100 ft), river crossing, then leaving the trail at a switchback near Hildebrand Creek into Green Creek. The 'Skookum Pasture logging road' could not be found anywhere; the bike-the-logging-road text matches the west-side Dailey Prairie approach to the Twin Sisters and was copied from another route. Ridge-specific beta in the same itinerary note ('stay left/west of the crest', 2nd-3rd class) is also likely copied but is tied to the unresolved grade question and was left untouched.

results.fact: Grade: Class 3-4 scramble vs 5.4 north ridge
results.evidence: Sources agree Skookum's north ridge, reached by rappelling off Jaws' Tooth, is 5.4 on solid olivine (Green Creek Circuit trip report; the circuit overall is rated IV 5.6). No source documents a standalone Class 3-4 'standard' route up Skookum; the only non-technical terrain described is the loose south/southwest face used as a descent on the circuit. Whether this row is the 5.4 north ridge or a Class 3-4 scramble is a route-identity decision (name and discipline say scramble; beta, face, rock_grade and pro_needs describe the north ridge), so no patch.

One trip report confirms a ~15 m rappel off Jaws' Tooth to reach Skookum's north ridge, for which a 30 m rope barely suffices. Whether rope_type 'none' or pro_needs' 30 m rope is right depends on whether this row is the north ridge or a scramble, which is unresolved above.

results.fact: Descent: reverse vs committing past Jaws' Tooth
results.evidence: Both circuit sources descend Skookum by its south/southwest face (described as loose) toward the col east of Hayden, not by reversing the north ridge; reversing would mean re-climbing Jaws' Tooth. The row, however, explicitly warns against the south slopes. Which descent applies depends on the unresolved route identity, and changing a safety-relevant descent needs that settled first.

results.correct_value: The Green Creek climbers' path leaves the Elbow Lake Trail at a switchback near Hildebrand Creek, about 1.5 miles past the river crossing — not at Elbow Lake after ~8 miles.
results.evidence: A guide-service trip report puts the departure from the Elbow Lake trail at a switchback (~2,650 ft) about 1.5 miles after the Middle Fork crossing, near Hildebrand Creek. A range overview and the circuit trip report likewise describe a blazed climbers' trail branching off the Elbow Lake trail at a switchback near Hildebrand Creek; the row's own junction waypoint agrees. Round-trip mileage was not settled: whole-circuit sources give 11-13 miles, below both the itinerary's 14 and watch_out's ~16, so those figures and dist_km were left alone.
